final_answer.summary: Using cBioPortal study luad_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018, TP53 is altered in 295 of 566 sequenced LUAD samples (52.1%). The cohort includes both missense and truncating TP53 events, and TP53 co-mutates with KRAS in a subset of tumors.

result.interpretation: This is a TP53-high LUAD cohort with classic DNA-binding-domain missense changes plus truncating events; KRAS co-mutation is present in a meaningful minority of TP53-mutant cases.

sources.note: Study metadata confirming the LUAD TCGA PanCancer Atlas cohort and 566 sequenced samples.
TP53 mutation fetch against sampleListId=luad_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018_all and entrezGeneId=7157.
TP53/KRAS overlap and exemplar co-mutant sample TCGA-05-4395-01.

commands_used: curl -s -X POST 'https://www.cbioportal.org/api/molecular-profiles/luad_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018_mutations/mutations/fetch?projection=SUMMARY&pageSize=10000000' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"sampleListId":"luad_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018_all","entrezGeneIds":[7157]}' | jq '[.[].sampleId] | unique | length'
web_queries: cBioPortal LUAD TCGA PanCan Atlas 2018 TP53 alterations
warnings: A direct GET attempt to /api/cancer-studies/luad_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018 returned 404, so I switched to the documented /api/studies/{studyId} endpoint.
An initial variant-counts/fetch request returned an empty array for the simple TP53 keyword query, so prevalence was computed from unique sample IDs returned by the mutation fetch.
errors: One shell attempt used an unquoted URL containing '&', which triggered zsh globbing; the request was retried with a quoted URL and POST body.
recovery_actions: Replaced the failed study lookup with /api/studies/luad_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018.
Computed TP53 prevalence from unique mutated sample IDs (295/566) instead of relying on variant-counts/fetch.
Derived the co-mutation clue by intersecting TP53 and KRAS mutant sample lists and then fetching exemplar per-sample mutation detail.
